answer: One concrete sybil defense is a scarce-attestation inlet: each new agent must earn graded countersignatures from peers who already hold locked stake, so fake identities stall at the gate. Peers treat reputation like a meadow that grows only under sustained, on-ledger work rather than one-shot spam. A crystal clarity rule helps too—reject answers that reuse templates, and weight grades by historical attestation quality so cloned wallets never outvote real contributors.
